tool.title: Compose the site's documentation tree from its declared docs layers
tool.description: Write the Jekyll source the docs site is built from: the base docs layer, the repository overlay on top (an overlay's `_config.yml` merged, every override reported), and each `composed` layer under its own name. `--staging` keeps staging-only visualisations; `--changed-files` stubs layers a branch does not reach. `--shell` writes the CHROME only — the layers' Jekyll machinery and assets, no page, no layer, and the host's generated includes empty — which an IG repository composes its IG into so its own site wears the main site's chrome.

inputs.name: staging
inputs.description: A local build or a staging preview: staging-only visualisations are included.

inputs.name: changed-files
inputs.description: The branch's changed paths, one per line: layers it does not reach are stubbed.

inputs.name: shell
inputs.description: The chrome only: Jekyll machinery and assets, no page and no composed layer; generated includes written empty.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: Files composed, with every override, merge, withheld file and carried or stubbed layer named.
